description: This file defines the Softirqs struct and functions to parse and retrieve softirq statistics from the Linux proc filesystem, specifically the 'softirqs' file.

classes.name: Softirqs
classes.description: Struct representing various softirq counters for different types of softirqs.

methods.name: FS.Softirqs
methods.description: Reads the 'softirqs' file from the proc filesystem and parses its contents into a Softirqs struct.

methods.name: parseSoftirqs
methods.description: Parses the data from the 'softirqs' file, extracting counters for each softirq type per CPU.
